content.text: I've read the plan and verified its intent structure against the live repo. Two defects survived verification.

findings.claim: End state 5 — "Declared instruction experiments and their delivery to the intended role survive packaging, including a regression scenario derived from each chosen hypothesis. · check: `node --test adapters/codex/skills/red-team/red-team-structure.test.mjs adapters/codex/package-red-team.test.mjs`" (plan line 97) — is checkable at the phase that last mutates its inputs.
findings.reality: Task 2 (Phase 2) is the last task before the mandatory operator install checkpoint, and its Files list (plan line 137) includes exactly the three role-instruction surfaces the structure test guards — `adapters/codex/skills/red-team/SKILL.md`, `adapters/codex/skills/red-team/agents/openai.yaml`, `adapters/codex/skills/red-team/references/host.md` — yet its acceptance command (plan line 144) is `node --test adapters/codex/package-red-team.test.mjs adapters/codex/skills/red-team/assets/red-team-runner.test.mjs adapters/codex/red-team-actual-host.test.mjs`, which omits `red-team-structure.test.mjs`. Task 1's Done-when (line 126) runs the structure test but cannot run `package-red-team.test.mjs` (that file is born in Task 2). So neither Phase 1 nor Phase 2 ever runs End state 5's check in full; only Task 3 (line 159) does, and Task 3 sits behind the mandatory Phase-2 stop (lines 107, 143). The Snipe precedent in this repo confirms a structure test is exactly what guards those files: `/Users/ljf/GitHub/WorkAuditRefine/.claude/worktrees/codex-red-team-migration-5ca53a/adapters/codex/skills/snipe/snipe-structure.test.mjs` lines 5-7 read `./SKILL.md`, `./agents/openai.yaml`, and `./references/codex-auditor.md`.

findings.planRef: ## Commander's Intent → End state 5; Phase 2 → Task 2 (Done when)
findings.fix: Add `adapters/codex/skills/red-team/red-team-structure.test.mjs` to Task 2's `Done when` command so End state 5's check runs in full before the mandatory Phase-2 handoff/install checkpoint — Task 2 rewrites SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml and references/host.md, and its current acceptance command cannot detect a regression in the packaged role instructions.

findings.claim: End state 6 is verifiable: "· HARD at audit_sha — final Snipe plan-faithfulness seat reads the ledger and samples its evidence links against the actual implementation/review history" (plan line 98).
findings.reality: The judged form is well-formed per this repo's doctrine (`skills/war-strategy/references/plan-interview.md:220` — `HARD at audit_sha (observable + judge seat)`; `plan-faithfulness` is a real Snipe-selectable lens per `skills/snipe/assets/snipe-args.mjs:20`, and Snipe pins `audit_sha` per `skills/snipe/SKILL.md:24`), but the plan never schedules that seat. In a WAR run the gate-audit seats attest untagged/judged conditions automatically (`skills/war/SKILL.md:33`), and the plan explicitly routes away from that path: "the operator intends implementation in another task using goal/Snipe, not automatic WAR dispatch" (line 105) and "The intended goal/Snipe implementer directly runs each task's explicit acceptance command" (line 111). Every occurrence of "Snipe" elsewhere in the plan (lines 89, 117, 118, 138, 141, 142, 154, 155) is Snipe-as-implementation/repair-methodology or Snipe-as-source-precedent — none convenes an audit. Task 3's own acceptance (line 159) is four `node --test` invocations with no audit step, and neither backstop B1 nor B2 (lines 167-168) mentions reading the ledger. End state 6 therefore has no defined moment or owner of evaluation on the plan's intended execution path.
findings.evidence: plan:98 `· HARD at audit_sha — final Snipe plan-faithfulness seat reads the ledger and samples its evidence links against the actual implementation/review history` | plan:105 `the operator intends implementation in another task using goal/Snipe, not automatic WAR dispatch` | plan:111 `The intended goal/Snipe implementer directly runs each task's explicit acceptance command.` | plan:159 Task 3 Done-when is `node --test ...` only | plan:167-168 B1/B2 make no reference to a ledger-reading seat | skills/war/SKILL.md:33 gate-audit seats attest judged conditions inside a WAR dispatch
findings.fix: Name where and by whom the judging seat runs, or re-tag the condition. Non-equivalent options: (a) add an explicit final `/snipe` invocation with a pinned `plan-faithfulness` seat and audit_sha to Task 3 or the Build order; (b) re-tag End state 6 as `backstop:` and add a third backstop (B3) with an operator runner/timing clause the way B1 is written; (c) declare WAR dispatch the judging path, which contradicts lines 105 and 111 as written. Only the operator can settle which verification they will actually perform.
